say:1:1620848001:0.text: Is it just me, or is something off about the library today?
say:1:1620848001:0.source_cn: 你们有没有觉得，今天图书馆有点不对劲？

say:2:1620848002:0.text: I had a tiff with my friend earlier...
say:2:1620848002:0.source_cn: 我和另一个同学意见不合，吵了几句，然后……

say:3:1620848003:0.text: I thought a magic broom was going to hit me... but it didn't!
say:3:1620848003:0.source_cn: 然后，竟然没有魔法扫帚打我的头！

say:4:1620848004:0.text: ... What, do you enjoy the pain or something?
say:4:1620848004:0.source_cn: ……你很希望被魔法扫帚揍一顿？

say:5:1620848005:0.text: No, the point is, I broke the school rules, but I wasn't punished!
say:5:1620848005:0.source_cn: 不是，我的意思是，我违规了，但没有受到惩罚！

say:7:1620848006:1.text: You're not the only one. Some other students have noticed that the school rules aren't as strict as they used to be. Are they still in force?
say:7:1620848006:1.source_cn: 最近确实有不少人都发现校规的约束没以前严了。难道校规已...

say:8:1620848007:1.text: Does this mean... I can skip classes whenever I want?
say:8:1620848007:1.source_cn: 这么说……我以后可以正大光明地逃课了？

say:10:1620848008:1.text: Listening to the students makes you realize just how essential Contess is, which is why she's allowed only one day of rest each year.

say:10:1620848008:1.female: Listening to the students makes you realize just how essential Contess is, which is why she's allowed only one day of rest each year.

narration:12:1620848010:1.text: You head back to the library and see Contess sitting by the rulebook, staring blankly into the distance...

narration:12:1620848010:1.female: You head back to the library and see Contess sitting by the rulebook, staring blankly into the distance...

say:14:1620848011:1.text: You're finally here, Merlin! I'm glad you remembered to come for me.

say:14:1620848011:1.male: You're finally here, Merlin! I'm glad you remembered to come for me.
say:14:1620848011:1.female: You're finally here, Merlin! I'm glad you remembered to come for me.

say:15:1620848012:1.text: Come on, let's go! I can't wait to start the game!
say:15:1620848012:1.source_cn: 走啦走啦，我已经迫不及待了，现在跑团才是最重要的事！
